_comment: Regression baseline for tests/integration/test_golden.py (guide 7.5). Floors are updated DELIBERATELY when a gate genuinely improves the score, and committed as a decision. Never auto-refresh this file: a golden that moves whenever the code moves is not a regression test.
_gate: 10 - the no-LLM checkpoint. Floors are what the DETERMINISTIC core achieves with zero LLM calls; L4 may raise them but must never lower them.
